notes: EHNOTE provides NO data dictionary, NO schema, and NO structured export format. The 'entities' listed here are reconstructed from the documentation's description of exported file categories. The 7 'fields' for CaseSheet PDFs are broad content categories (e.g., 'Patient demographics', 'Medications'), NOT individual database fields. The documentation explicitly states: 'There is no one size fits all set of fields in the software because of the extensive customization that is possible.'
